content.introduction: The U.S. economy showed solid growth in the third quarter of 2025 with stable inflation and low unemployment. Inflation remained low, and unemployment stayed near the non-cyclical rate. Treasury borrowing needs remain manageable.
body:
Economic data received through September 30, 2025, suggest that U.S. economic growth solidified in the third quarter of 2025 with steady business investment and consumer demand. Stock markets reached record highs during the quarter—and have set additional highs since—while earnings growth has been stable.
